```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
# Mw.gmm: scalar for a flat magnitude, or a named vector keyed by TRT
# for scenario-linked magnitudes (e.g. c(ASC = 7.7, SCC = 5.5, SIF = 9)).
# No shared ephemerals here: knitBlock children run in the global env
# and rm() the canonical names (AUX et al.).
for (Trt in sort(unique(GMPETable$TRT))) {
  Mw.target <- if (!exists("Mw.gmm", inherits = FALSE)) 6.5 else if (is.null(names(Mw.gmm))) Mw.gmm[[1L]] else if (Trt %in% names(Mw.gmm)) Mw.gmm[[Trt]] else 6.5
  cat(sprintf(
    "\n\n## Ground Motion Models<br>%s (%s)\n\n",
    switch(Trt,
      ASC = "Active Shallow Crust",
      SCC = "Stable Continental Crust",
      SIF = "Subduction Interface",
      SIS = "Subduction Intraslab",
      Trt
    ),
    Trt
  ))
  cat("::: {.panel-tabset}\n\n")
  cat("### Attenuation\n\n")
  NGR::knitBlock(
    path = "/_fig/GMPE.qmd",
    stem = paste0("gmm-", tolower(Trt), "-att"),
    labels = "rewrite",
    vars = list(ID.target = unique(GMPETable[TRT == Trt, ID]), Mw.target = Mw.target),
    root = root
  )
  cat("\n\n### Spectra\n\n")
  NGR::knitBlock(
    path = "/_fig/GMPE.PSA.qmd",
    stem = paste0("gmm-", tolower(Trt), "-psa"),
    labels = "rewrite",
    vars = list(ID.target = unique(GMPETable[TRT == Trt, ID]), Mw.target = Mw.target, Repi.target = 100),
    root = root
  )
  cat("\n\n:::\n\n")
}
rm(Trt, Mw.target)
```
